agents_acp_binding_check.name: agents_acp_binding_check
agents_acp_binding_check.value: "agents"."engine" <> 'acp' or ("agents"."runner_id" is not null and "agents"."adapter" is not null and "agents"."workspace" is not null)

principals_kind_identity_check.name: principals_kind_identity_check
principals_kind_identity_check.value:
("principals"."kind" = 'human' and "principals"."user_id" is not null and "principals"."owner_id" is null)
				or ("principals"."kind" = 'unit' and "principals"."user_id" is null and "principals"."owner_id" is null)
				or ("principals"."kind" = 'agent' and "principals"."user_id" is null and "principals"."owner_id" is not null)

task_logs_owner_check.name: task_logs_owner_check
task_logs_owner_check.value: "task_logs"."task_id" is not null or "task_logs"."run_id" is not null
